description:
[Game reference] Armour inserts: protection added, clothing with insert slots, slot odds. `inserts`: each insert with `protection` per damage type in percent (added to the clothing's own, per insert) and
`speed_reduction`. `clothing`: every item with insert slots (`min`/`max` slots, `crafted_only` - looted armour has
none, `covers` body parts, base `protection_pct`). `slot_odds`: chance of each slot count at craft time, keyed
"min-max", with no crafting-quality bonus. Insert protection is added per insert, on top of the clothing. Link https://rust.wiki/armour-inserts.
name: get_armour_inserts
title: Armour inserts: protection added, clothing with insert slots, slot odds
